Dressmaker Troubleshooting

Dressmaker is a small, well-behaved game, so when something breaks it is usually Steam, a driver, macOS Gatekeeper or your network.

Reviewed September 21, 2026

  • Most commonOut-of-date GPU drivers
  • macOSGatekeeper blocks the itch.io prototype
  • StutterBackground apps, drivers, thermals
  • itch.ioZips are 115–128 MB, check the download
  • SavesSteam Cloud is listed; back up anyway
  • BugsOfficial Steam discussions

Dressmaker problems are usually one of five things: an out-of-date GPU driver, the macOS Gatekeeper warning on the un-notarized itch.io prototype, a partial download, a laptop throttling, or a blocked network.

The two builds need different fixes — see the dressmaker game home page.

Find your problem

SymptomMost likely causeSection

Runs, but stuttersOverlays and heatStutter
macOS calls it maliciousNot notarizedmacOS warning

Tip

verifying the game files and updating your GPU driver clear most reports. Try both first.

1. Will not start on Windows

You press Play, Steam says running, and nothing appears.

  1. 1

    Verify the game files

    Steam → right-click Dressmaker → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity.

  2. 2

    Update your GPU driver

    from Intel, AMD or NVIDIA, not Windows Update. UHD 630 and DirectX 11 are the minimum.

  3. 3

    Run as administrator

    right-click → Manage → Browse local files → Properties → Compatibility.

  4. 4

    Check Windows 10 or later

    Settings → System → About. Older versions are unsupported.

  5. 5

    Check antivirus quarantine

    restore the game's files, then exclude your Steam library.

  6. 6

    Try the publicbeta branch last

    SteamDB lists one as “Experimental and untested changes”.

2. Stuttering or a low frame rate

FixWhy it works
Close browsers, launchers and overlaysThey fight the game for the same GPU
Install fresh GPU driversFresh drivers matter more than raw power
Go windowed, drop a resolution stepThe game still looks fine
Use a hard surface and clear the ventsA laptop that crawls after ten minutes is hot, not slow
Check the published minimum8 GB RAM and an i5 or Ryzen; Apple M1 on Mac

No recommended tier is published: Dressmaker system requirements.

3. The macOS warning

The itch.io prototype is not notarized, so macOS blocks it as unverified.

  1. 1

    Open System Settings

    then Privacy & Security.

  2. 2

    Click Open Anyway

    in the security section.

  3. 3

    Confirm the second prompt

    the prototype opens.

Tip

that button appears only after macOS blocks the app once, so try opening the game first.

Note

the Steam release installs normally; if it will not open, verify the files in Steam.

4. The itch.io zip

File (version 0.5.5)PlatformSize
Dressmaker Prototype Windows 0.5.5.zipWindows115 MB
Dressmaker Prototype Linux 0.5.5.zipLinux127 MB
Dressmaker Prototype OSX 0.5.5.zipmacOS128 MB
FixWhy it works
Download it againA partial file is much smaller than the listed size
Open it with 7-Zip or The UnarchiverExplorer and Archive Utility fail on big downloads
Clear a couple of gigabytesUnzipping needs that much space again
Retry later or on another networkA crawling download is itch.io or your ISP

5. itch.io will not load

  • Try a second browser — then a private window, extensions off.
  • Turn off your VPN and try another network — a hotspot rules out your connection.
  • School and office networks block game sites.

Direct download: Dressmaker demo.

6. Saves and Steam Cloud

Steam Cloud is listed, so progress should follow your account.

QuestionHonest answer
Cloud supported?Yes, it is listed
Which files sync?Unpublished
Where is the save folder?Unverified; we will not invent a path
How do I find it?Right-click Dressmaker → Manage → Browse local files; per-game data also sits under userdata, your account ID, App ID 4019220

Warning

no save path is verified, and reinstalling can overwrite progress. Copy the whole folder first.

7. You cut the wrong fabric

There is no undo: the cut is what shows on the finished dress.

  • Preview on the mannequin — the last free check before every cut.
  • Practice on cheap cotton — learn the layout before you buy velvet.

Warning

cutting is permanent. Fabric is spent the moment the shears go through it.

More layout advice: Dressmaker sewing tips.

8. Reporting a bug

Report it in the Dressmaker Steam discussions or the developers' Discord (invite on the itch.io page).

  • Your build — Steam branch or prototype file name.
  • Platform and hardware — OS and graphics card.
  • Steps to reproduce, and what happened instead.
  • A screenshot, plus your save file if progress is involved.

When to report it

Work down this ladder and stop when the problem is solved.

  1. 1

    Restart Steam and verify the game files.

  2. 2

    Update your OS and graphics driver.

  3. 3

    Work through the matching section above.

  4. 4

    Check the Dressmaker patch notes

    a hotfix may be out.

  5. 5

    Report it

    Steam discussions or Discord.

  6. 6

    Still stuck?

    tell us.

Frequently asked questions

  1. Does Dressmaker support Steam Cloud?

    Yes, it is listed among the game's Steam features, but the developers have not published which files sync. Keep your own copy of anything you would hate to lose.

  2. Can I undo a cut in Dressmaker?

    No. Cutting is irreversible by design. Practice on cheap cotton and preview on the mannequin first.

  3. Why does macOS say the prototype may be malicious?

    Because it is not notarized, so macOS cannot verify the developer. The fix is System Settings, Privacy & Security, then Open Anyway.

  4. Where do I report a Dressmaker bug?

    In the official Steam discussions or the developers' Discord, with your build, platform, exact steps and a screenshot.

  5. Why will my antivirus not let Dressmaker run?

    Heuristic scanners sometimes quarantine files from small studios. Check your protection history, restore them and exclude your Steam library.
